other_conditions: Must have worked as a full‑time journalist/media professional for a minimum of 20 years in Jharkhand or undivided Bihar (pre‑November 15 2000).
Must not be a pension beneficiary of any other media institution or government scheme.
Must have retired at the age of 58 or as per the retirement norms of the media organization.
Must possess an accreditation certificate issued by the Directorate of Information and Public Relations at the time of retirement.
Must not have any criminal convictions leading to imprisonment of more than two years.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹7,500 with a family pension of 50% to the spouse after the journalist’s demise.
